title: Sea Foam Green Toilet Paper Stand, 29-Inch Freestanding Euro Style Toilet Tissue Holder - Carolina, Allied Brass
description:
Solve the problem of limited wall space and keep a roll right where you want it—no drilling required in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. This freestanding toilet paper stand brings traditional bathroom hardware styling to your bath while adding stability with a heavy base to help prevent tipping.

- Place tissue next to the toilet anywhere you need it (freestanding)
- European-style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy
- Solid brass construction for an enduring, classic bath accessories look
- Traditional design with classic elements to suit heritage bathroom fixtures
- Backed by a limited lifetime warranty

This floor stand works as a toilet paper stand, toilet tissue holder, and toilet roll holder in one. Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection—ideal for a matching Carolina setup.

Specs: 8 in L x 27 in H x 6 in W. Material: brass. Mounting: freestanding/floor stand (no wall mount). Assembly required. Included: toilet tissue stand. Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs. Warranty: limited lifetime.
